pairs.target: ài kē bǎ yìtiáo lán zhǐ fàngdào tǎ wéi shǒubiān , jiào tā biéjí zhe mō tiě .
pairs.english: Eko placed a strip of blue paper beside Tavi's hand and told him not to touch the iron yet.
pairs.hanzi: 艾珂把一条蓝纸放到塔维手边，叫他别急着摸铁。

pairs.target: zhǐ hěn báo , cái dé yì zhǐ kuān , mòduān huà le gè xiǎo yuán .
pairs.english: The paper was thin, cut a finger wide, with a small circle drawn at one end.
pairs.hanzi: 纸很薄，裁得一指宽，末端画了个小圆。

pairs.target: zhuōshàng de liǎngkuài tiěpiàn gè jiá zài ǎi mùjià lǐ , jiàzi qiántou xuán zhe xiǎo pèizhòng ,
pairs.english: Each of the two iron plates on the table was clamped in a low wooden frame, with a small counterweight hanging at the front.
pairs.hanzi: 桌上的两块铁片各夹在矮木架里，架子前头悬着小配重，

pairs.target: pèizhòng yì lā , tiěpiàn biàn huì shāoshāo wān xià .
pairs.english: The pull of the weight bent the plate slightly downward.
pairs.hanzi: 配重一拉，铁片便会稍稍弯下。

pairs.target: zuǒbiān piàn xià liú le yídào zhǎi fèng , lán zhǐ yào cóng nàlǐ sòng guòqù , bǎ yuán lù dào lìngyícè .
pairs.english: Beneath the left plate was a narrow gap: the blue paper had to pass through it until the circle showed on the other side.
pairs.hanzi: 左边片下留了一道窄缝，蓝纸要从那里送过去，把圆露到另一侧。

pairs.target: " yòng shǒu sòng , bùxǔ chuī . " ài kē shuō .
pairs.english: “Use your hand, no blowing,” Eko said.
pairs.hanzi: “用手送，不许吹。”艾珂说。

pairs.target: luò héng yǐjīng fǔ xiàshēn , wényán táitóu , shuō tā zhǐshì xiǎng kànqīngchǔ .
pairs.english: Lohen had already bent down. He looked up at this and said he only wanted a closer look.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡已经俯下身，闻言抬头，说他只是想看清楚。

pairs.target: tā shuō nà hěn hǎo , qùnián yǒurén chuī guò , bǎ zhǐ chuījìn le huǒpén .
pairs.english: She said that was good: someone had blown last year and sent the paper into a brazier.
pairs.hanzi: 她说那很好，去年有人吹过，把纸吹进了火盆。

pairs.target: huǒ méi diǎn , xiàoshēng dǎo chàdiǎn bǎ lǎoshī yǐnlái .
pairs.english: The fire wasn't lit, but the laughter nearly brought the teacher over.
pairs.hanzi: 火没点，笑声倒差点把老师引来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ zhǐ zài zhǐ jiān zhuǎn le yíxià .
pairs.english: Tavi turned the paper between his fingers.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把纸在指间转了一下。

pairs.target: zhè jǐtiān tā yòu liàn guò liǎnghuí liú chí , yìhuí gāng lí shǒu jiù sàn , yìhuí miǎnqiǎng guò le yìshēng .
pairs.english: He had practiced retention twice more these last few days: once it faded as soon as his hands left, and once it barely lasted past one click.
pairs.hanzi: 这几天他又练过两回留持，一回刚离手就散，一回勉强过了一声。

pairs.target: shàngcì nà liǎngshēng hái zài jìlù shàng , què búhuì yīnwèi tā jìde , jiù měicì dōu kěnhuílái .
pairs.english: Those two clicks from last time remained in his record, but remembering them would not make them return every time.
pairs.hanzi: 上次那两声还在记录上，却不会因为他记得，就每次都肯回来。

pairs.target: gěi jiālǐ de xìn yǐjīng jìzǒu .
pairs.english: His letter home had been posted.
pairs.hanzi: 给家里的信已经寄走。

pairs.target: děng huíxìn de kòngdāng , kè zhàocháng pái zhe , jīntiān lún dào bǎ yìshuāng kōng chūlái de shǒu zhēnzhèng yòng yícì .
pairs.english: While waiting for a reply, classes continued as usual. Today he would actually use a pair of freed hands.
pairs.hanzi: 等回信的空当，课照常排着，今天轮到把一双空出来的手真正用一次。

pairs.target: tā xiānqián yǐwéi , zhǐyào néng lí shǒu , hòumiàn de shì zìrán huì zuò ; kànjiàn lán zhǐ , cái juéde nà diǎn shíjiān hūrán biànzhǎi le .
pairs.english: He had thought that once he could lift his hands, everything afterward would follow naturally; seeing the blue paper made that sliver of time suddenly feel narrower.
pairs.hanzi: 他先前以为，只要能离手，后面的事自然会做；看见蓝纸，才觉得那点时间忽然变窄了。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī jiǎnchá guò zhěngkuài de liáng hé jiēchùqū , yòu kàn le mùjià xià de dǎng kuài .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey checked the whole volumes and contact areas, then the stops beneath the frames.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师检查过整块的量和接触区，又看了木架下的挡块。

pairs.target: tā ràng tāmen xiān bú liàn liú chí , zhī zuò píngshí de jiēchù jiāohuàn .
pairs.english: She told them to start with the usual exchange while touching, without practicing retention yet.
pairs.hanzi: 她让他们先不练留持，只做平时的接触交换。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuāngshǒu fēnbié tiē wěn , liǎngbiān de wānqū yǒu le bùtóng , zuǒbiān de zhǎi fèng zhāngdà yìdiǎn ,
pairs.english: Tavi settled one hand on each plate; their bending changed differently, and the left gap widened slightly.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维双手分别贴稳，两边的弯曲有了不同，左边的窄缝张大一点，

pairs.target: luò héng bǎ zhǐ píngpíng sòng le guòqù .
pairs.english: Lohen slid the paper flat through it.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡把纸平平送了过去。

pairs.target: děng yuán lùchū lái , lǎoshī jiàotíng .
pairs.english: Once the circle emerged, the teacher called stop.
pairs.hanzi: 等圆露出来，老师叫停。

pairs.target: biànhuà tuìhuí , tiěpiàn qīngqīng jiázhù zhǐbiān , méiyǒu pèngdào xiàmiàn de dǎng kuài .
pairs.english: The change reversed, and the iron gently gripped the paper's edge without touching the stop below.
pairs.hanzi: 变化退回，铁片轻轻夹住纸边，没有碰到下面的挡块。

pairs.target: luò héng sōngshǒu , zhǐ guà zài nàlǐ , xiàng cóng tiě zuǐlǐ shēnchū de yì jié shétou .
pairs.english: Lohen let go. The paper hung there like a little tongue sticking out of an iron mouth.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡松手，纸挂在那里，像从铁嘴里伸出的一截舌头。

pairs.target: " yuánlái jiù zhèyàng . " tǎ wéi shuō .
pairs.english: “So that's all,” Tavi said.
pairs.hanzi: “原来就这样。”塔维说。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī wèn tā shìbushì shīwàng . tā yáotóu , yòu chéngrèn yuánlái yǐwéi huì gèng xiàng yíjiàn dàshì .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey asked whether he was disappointed. He shook his head, then admitted he had expected it to feel like something bigger.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师问他是不是失望。他摇头，又承认原来以为会更像一件大事。

pairs.target: lǎoshī ná qǐ lìng yìtiáo zhǐ , shuō děnghuìer tā ruò mángbúguòlái , kěyǐ zài qǐng luò héng , tā de shǒu bìng méiyǒu bèi zhè mén kèshōu zǒu .
pairs.english: The teacher picked up another strip, saying that if he got too busy later he could ask Lohen again: this class had not confiscated Lohen's hands.
pairs.hanzi: 老师拿起另一条纸，说等会儿他若忙不过来，可以再请洛衡，他的手并没有被这门课收走。

pairs.target: dìyīcì huànchéng tǎ wéi zìjǐ sòng , tā bǎ lán zhǐjiá zài liǎng zhǐ zhījiān , xiān wěnzhù jiāohuàn , zài yìqǐ táishǒu .
pairs.english: On his first solo attempt, Tavi held the blue paper between two fingers, steadied the exchange, then lifted both hands together.
pairs.hanzi: 第一次换成塔维自己送，他把蓝纸夹在两指之间，先稳住交换，再一起抬手。

pairs.target: zhǐzhēn tíng le yíxià , tā yǐjīng qù zhuī zhǐ .
pairs.english: The pointer paused, and he was already reaching after the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 指针停了一下，他已经去追纸。

pairs.target: zhǐtóu què bèi zìjǐ de xiùkǒu dài piān , cā zài mùjià biān , zhé chū yígèjiǎo .
pairs.english: But his cuff dragged the tip sideways; it scraped the frame and folded a corner.
pairs.hanzi: 纸头却被自己的袖口带偏，擦在木架边，折出一个角。

pairs.target: fénghé shàng le . yuán hái zài tā zhèbiān .
pairs.english: The gap closed. The circle was still on his side.
pairs.hanzi: 缝合上了。圆还在他这边。

pairs.target: tā dīng zhe nàtiáo zhézhǐ , xiānshì xiǎng xiào , jiēzhe yǒudiǎn nǎo .
pairs.english: Staring at the folded paper, he first wanted to laugh, then felt annoyed.
pairs.hanzi: 他盯着那条折纸，先是想笑，接着有点恼。

pairs.target: búshì tiěpiàn méi liúzhù , shì tā méi bǎ zuì jiǎndān de dōngxī sòng guòqù .
pairs.english: It wasn't that the iron hadn't held the effect; he had failed to pass through the simplest thing.
pairs.hanzi: 不是铁片没留住，是他没把最简单的东西送过去。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhǐ tān píng , yuè mǒ yuè kàndéjiàn nà dàobái zhéhén .
pairs.english: He flattened the paper, but the more he rubbed it, the clearer the pale crease became.
pairs.hanzi: 他把纸摊平，越抹越看得见那道白折痕。

pairs.target: ài kē jiào tā bié zài mǒ , dì lái xīn de .
pairs.english: Eko told him to stop rubbing and handed him a fresh one.
pairs.hanzi: 艾珂叫他别再抹，递来新的。

pairs.target: lǎoshī ràng tā lí zhuō hēshuǐ , luò héng què bǎ huài zhǐ ná le guòqù , zhào gāngcái de zīshì shìleshì , xiùzǐ yě pèngdào jiàzi .
pairs.english: The teacher sent him away from the table for water, while Lohen took the damaged strip and tried his posture; his sleeve hit the frame too.
pairs.hanzi: 老师让他离桌喝水，洛衡却把坏纸拿了过去，照刚才的姿势试了试，袖子也碰到架子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zài bēi yán shàngfāng kànzhe tā .
pairs.english: Tavi watched him over the rim of his cup.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维在杯沿上方看着他。

pairs.target: luò héng huàn le gè zhuā fǎ , shǒuwàn wǎng wài zhuǎn , bǎ yuán liúzài zhǐ de yuǎnduān , méiyǒu zài qù zhuā zuì qiántou .
pairs.english: Lohen changed his grip and turned his wrist outward, leaving the circle at the far end instead of grasping the tip.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡换了个抓法，手腕往外转，把圆留在纸的远端，没有再去抓最前头。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zǒu huílái shí , tā yǐjīng bǎ zhuōshàng sàn zhǐ nuókāi , kōng chū néng zhíjiē táishǒu de wèizhì .
pairs.english: By the time Tavi came back, he had moved loose paper aside, clearing a direct path for lifting a hand.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维走回来时，他已经把桌上散纸挪开，空出能直接抬手的位置。

pairs.target: " búshì shuō nǐ huì shūgěi zhǐ . " tā shuō , " shì zhǐ búhuì tì nǐ duǒ xiùzǐ . "
pairs.english: “I'm not saying you'll lose to paper,” he said. “Paper just won't dodge your sleeve for you.”
pairs.hanzi: “不是说你会输给纸。”他说，“是纸不会替你躲袖子。”

pairs.target: dìèrhuí , tǎ wéi bǎ xiùkǒu zhé gāo , xiān shì le yíbiàn méiyǒu jiè xìng de dòngzuò .
pairs.english: For the second attempt Tavi folded up his cuffs and rehearsed the movement without borrowing.
pairs.hanzi: 第二回，塔维把袖口折高，先试了一遍没有借性的动作。

pairs.target: liǎng zhǐ niān zhù hòu bànjié , wǎngqián sòng , tuìhuílái .
pairs.english: Two fingers pinching the back half: forward, then back.
pairs.hanzi: 两指拈住后半截，往前送，退回来。

pairs.target: lán yuán cóng zhǎi fèng wài lüèguò , lí mùbiāo zhī chà hěnxiǎo de yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: The blue circle skimmed outside the narrow gap, only a little short of its destination.
pairs.hanzi: 蓝圆从窄缝外掠过，离目标只差很小的一点。

pairs.target: děng shǒuxià de tiěpiàn wěnzhù , tā méiyǒu dīng zhǐzhēn , yǎnjīng luò zài nàtiáo tōnglù shang .
pairs.english: Once the iron under his hands steadied, he looked at the passage rather than the pointer.
pairs.hanzi: 等手下的铁片稳住，他没有盯指针，眼睛落在那条通路上。

pairs.target: shuāngshǒu líkāi , yòushǒu xiàngqián , zuǒshǒu tíng zài yuánchù shàngfāng .
pairs.english: Both hands lifted; the right moved forward, while the left stayed above its original place.
pairs.hanzi: 双手离开，右手向前，左手停在原处上方。

pairs.target: zhǐtóu chuān jìn fènglǐ , lán yuán chūlái le .
pairs.english: The paper tip passed through the gap. The blue circle emerged.
pairs.hanzi: 纸头穿进缝里，蓝圆出来了。

pairs.target: tā sōngkāi zhǐ , liǎnggè zhǐ fù tóngshí huídào jiēchùqū , bǎ jiāohuàn jiěkāi .
pairs.english: He released the paper, returned both fingertips to the contact areas together, and unwound the exchange.
pairs.hanzi: 他松开纸，两个指腹同时回到接触区，把交换解开。

pairs.target: tiěpiàn jiázhù zhǐbiān , yuán zài lìngyícè qīngqīng huàng .
pairs.english: The plate gripped the paper's edge, and the circle swayed gently on the far side.
pairs.hanzi: 铁片夹住纸边，圆在另一侧轻轻晃。

pairs.target: mù bǎi de shēngyīn zhèshí cái zhuīshànglái shìde , zài tā ěrbiān xiǎng le yíxià .
pairs.english: Only then did the pendulum's sound seem to catch up, clicking once beside his ear.
pairs.hanzi: 木摆的声音这时才追上来似的，在他耳边响了一下。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī wèn tā gāngcái shìbushì yòng le gèng jiǔ .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey asked whether he had used more time just then.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师问他刚才是不是用了更久。

pairs.target: tā chuǎn le kǒuqì , shuō bù zhīdào , hǎoxiàng méiyǒu .
pairs.english: He drew a breath and said he didn't know; it didn't feel like it.
pairs.hanzi: 他喘了口气，说不知道，好像没有。

pairs.target: luò héng bǎ jìlù zhuǎn lái , quèshí méiyǒu bǐ nàcì liǎngshēng gèng cháng , dòngzuò dǎo yǐjīng zuò wán le .
pairs.english: Lohen turned the record toward him. It had indeed lasted no longer than those earlier two clicks, but the action was finished.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡把记录转来，确实没有比那次两声更长，动作倒已经做完了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànzhe zìjǐ de yòushǒu . nà zhī shǒu gānggāng búbì liúzài tiě shàng , néng qù zuò lìng yíjiàn shì .
pairs.english: Tavi looked at his right hand. A moment ago it had not needed to stay on the iron: it could do something else.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看着自己的右手。那只手刚刚不必留在铁上，能去做另一件事。

pairs.target: tā hūrán xiǎngqǐ nài lěi zhuāng kòuzǐ shí yìzhí tiēzhe de liǎngzhīshǒu , míngbái tā wèishénme yǒushíhòu hái xūyào pángbiān nàge rén .
pairs.english: He suddenly remembered Nerai's two hands staying in contact while fitting the clip, and understood why she sometimes still needed the person beside her.
pairs.hanzi: 他忽然想起奈蕾装扣子时一直贴着的两只手，明白她为什么有时候还需要旁边那个人。

pairs.target: " yǐhòu wǒ néng zìjǐ zhuāng nàge kòuzǐ ma ? "
pairs.english: “Will I be able to fit that clip myself someday?”
pairs.hanzi: “以后我能自己装那个扣子吗？”

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī shuō chǐcùn , cáiliào hé fùzài dōu yào lìng kàn , zhè zhāng zhuōzi de jiéguǒ bùnéng zhíjiē bān guòqù .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey said the size, material, and load would all need separate consideration; this table's result could not simply be transferred there.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师说尺寸、材料和负载都要另看，这张桌子的结果不能直接搬过去。

pairs.target: búguò jīntiān , zhǐ quèshí shì tā zìjǐ sòngjìnqù de .
pairs.english: But today he had indeed passed the paper through himself.
pairs.hanzi: 不过今天，纸确实是他自己送进去的。

pairs.target: tā bǎ jìlù shàng de nà yíxiàng zhǐ gěi tā kàn , ràng tā zìjǐ xiě wánchéng .
pairs.english: She pointed out that entry in the record and let him write “completed” himself.
pairs.hanzi: 她把记录上的那一项指给他看，让他自己写完成。

pairs.target: tā xiě dé hěn màn , zì bǐ qián jǐtiān de shuōmíng pái dà .
pairs.english: He wrote slowly, with larger characters than on the label a few days earlier.
pairs.hanzi: 他写得很慢，字比前几天的说明牌大。

pairs.target: zhǐjiān méiyǒu má , yǎnjīng què yǐjīng fāsuān , lǎoshī yě méiyǒu zài gěi dìsāntiáo zhǐ .
pairs.english: His fingertips were not numb, but his eyes ached; the teacher gave him no third strip.
pairs.hanzi: 指尖没有麻，眼睛却已经发酸，老师也没有再给第三条纸。

pairs.target: xiàkèshí , tā bǎ chénggōng de lán zhǐ hé zhé huài de nàtiáo bìng zhe shōu hǎo .
pairs.english: At the end of class he put away the successful blue paper alongside the crumpled one.
pairs.hanzi: 下课时，他把成功的蓝纸和折坏的那条并着收好。

pairs.target: luò héng wèn huài de yě liú ma .
pairs.english: Lohen asked if he was keeping the bad one too.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡问坏的也留吗。

pairs.target: tā shuō liú , miǎnde yǐhòu jiǎng qǐlái , bǎ xiùzǐ zhè yíduàn wàng le .
pairs.english: He said yes, so that when he told the story later he wouldn't forget the part with the sleeve.
pairs.hanzi: 他说留，免得以后讲起来，把袖子这一段忘了。

pairs.target: zǒuláng lǐ , mǐlā ná zhe jièlái de qiáo zuò tú děng kōng zhuō .
pairs.english: In the corridor, Mira waited for a free table with borrowed bridge-bearing drawings.
pairs.hanzi: 走廊里，米拉拿着借来的桥座图等空桌。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ zhǐ shēn gěi tā kàn , zhèngyào cóngtóu jiǎng , zhǐ bèi fēng yíjuàn tiē dào tā liǎnshàng .
pairs.english: Tavi held out the paper to show her and was about to start his story when the wind blew it onto his face.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把纸伸给她看，正要从头讲，纸被风一卷贴到他脸上。

pairs.target: tā tì tā jiē xiàlái , shuō xiānjìn qù , zhèhuí bié zài ràng zhǐ yíng le .
pairs.english: She peeled it off for him and said to go inside first: don't let the paper win again this time.
pairs.hanzi: 她替他揭下来，说先进去，这回别再让纸赢了。
